why: Options 1-4 are the same arrow-like shape with a V notch and a straight tail; they are only turned or flipped. In option 5 the tail is bent at a different angle, so the outline itself is different from all the others.
trick: First check whether the outlines are really identical; a changed angle beats a rotation.
note: By outline matching, option 4 is a mirror image of options 1-3, while option 5 has a genuinely different outline (bent tail). The book treats flipped shapes as the same and marks 5; this explanation follows the book.
